format: The video's fundamental structure — routine-demo, get-unready, efficacy-test, testimonial, talk-to-camera, celebrity-bumper, packshot-only, skit-dialogue, tutorial-howto, montage.
presenter_role: Who presents, from on-screen cues only — celebrity, everyday-creator, expert-professional, brand-model, multiple, none.
presenter_gender: Gender of the main presenter — female, male, multiple, none.
presenter_age_band: Visual age estimate of the main presenter — late-teens-20s, 30s, 40s-plus, mixed, none.
presenter_skin_tone: Main presenter's apparent skin tone as a neutral casting attribute, banded on the Monk scale — light, medium-light, medium, medium-deep, deep, unclear, none.
hair_type_shown: Hair texture in the final/healthy state — straight, wavy, curly, coily, unclear, none.
hair_length_shown: Hair length shown — above-shoulder, shoulder-length, mid-back, waist-or-longer, unclear, none.
hair_state_before: The problem hair state the ad opens on — frizzy, dry-rough, tangled-knotted, dull-lifeless, breakage-split-ends, greasy-limp, tightly-styled, none-shown.
hair_state_after: The result hair state presented — smooth-sleek, shiny-glossy, soft-bouncy, detangled, voluminous, frizz-free, none-shown.
setting: Where the video takes place — bathroom-shower, bedroom, vanity-mirror, salon, kitchen, living-room, outdoor, plain-studio, multiple, unclear.
language_spoken: Language actually spoken in the audio.
audio_mode: How the soundtrack is built — presenter-sync-sound, voiceover, dialogue, music-only, asmr-product-sound.
subtitle_script: How burned-in captions are written — native-script, romanized, english, mixed, none.
hook: The attention device of the first 3 seconds — problem-reveal, routine-in-progress, question-to-viewer, bold-claim, curiosity-tease, celebrity-face, product-hero, text-card, transformation-teaser, direct-greeting.
hook_verbal_line: Short English paraphrase of the first line spoken in the first 3 seconds.
hook_visual: What is on screen in the first 3 seconds — face-close-up, hair-close-up, full-body, product-close-up, text-card, scene, split-screen.
hook_presenter_action: What the presenter is doing in the first 3 seconds — talking, undoing-hairstyle, touching-hair, washing-or-applying, posing, walking-entering, none.
hook_emotion: Emotion performed in the first 3 seconds — confident, playful, frustrated, excited, calm, conspiratorial, aspirational-glamorous, neutral, none.
ai_content_label: Whether a visible AI-generated content tag appears — yes or no.
paid_disclosure: How the commercial relationship is declared — ad-tag, paid-partnership-label, brand-handle-tag-only, none-visible.
scene_description: Factual 2-4 sentence description of what happens from start to end.
product_featured: Each distinct named product shown or named (multi-value).
ingredient_claim: Each distinct named ingredient or technology, e.g. pro-v melting pearls (multi-value).
benefit_claim: Each distinct benefit asserted, e.g. reverses up to 3 years of damage, rebuilds broken bonds (multi-value).
damage_cause_named: Each cause the ad blames for hair damage — heat-styling, coloring-chemical, hot-water, daily-washing, tight-hairstyles, pollution, sun-exposure (multi-value).
claim_disclaimer: Each asterisk/footnote qualifying a claim; the label says what it qualifies, evidence carries the verbatim fine print (multi-value).
demo_device: Each distinct way the product's effect is proven on screen — pearls-melting-closeup, comb-glide, before-after-split, molecular-bond-animation, shower-rinse, packshot-hero and similar (multi-value).
cta: Each distinct call-to-action and where it appears (multi-value).
link_mechanic: How the viewer reaches the product — comment-keyword, link-in-bio, platform-cta-button, on-screen-badge, none-stated.
hashtag_campaign: Branded campaign hashtag or named challenge, bare and lowercase.
social_proof: Type of proof claim — creator rating, user count, expert endorsement, award, bestseller claim.
offer: Any actual incentive — discount, free gift, bundle, limited offer.
emotional_register: Dominant emotional tones, at most two (multi-value).
emotional_driver: The viewer need the ad speaks to — damage-guilt, appearance-confidence, hair-fall-anxiety, manageability-frustration, self-care-ritual, peer-approval, expert-trust (multi-value).
subtitle_style: Visual design of the captions, as colour + shape.
end_card: Short label for the closing frame — duo packshot, single packshot, logo card, claim super, cta badge, creator holding product.
notable_device: Escape hatch: any prominent deliberate creative device no other facet covers (multi-value).
product_range: Sub-brand / range name the product belongs to, e.g. miracle rescue, hair science.
product_format: Physical pack format shown — tub, tube, bottle, sachet, pump-bottle, multiple, none-shown.
wash_ritual_shown: Which wash steps the ad depicts — full-wash-routine, conditioner-only, shampoo-only, leave-in-styling, no-wash-shown.
retail_channel_cue: Named place to buy — amazon, flipkart, nykaa, quick-commerce, modern-trade-store, brand-website, none-stated.
pacing: Overall edit rhythm — slow-single-take, moderate, fast-cut, rapid-montage.
sound_dependency: Whether the ad communicates with sound off — works-muted, partially-dependent, sound-essential.
brand_first_appearance_seconds: Seconds until the Pantene brand is first identifiable (bare number).
product_reveal_seconds: Seconds until the product pack is first clearly shown (bare number).
transformation_reveal_seconds: Seconds until the after/result hair is first presented (bare number).
cta_timing_seconds: Seconds until the call-to-action first appears (bare number).
